reconcile.note: Fausset and his co-authors read Galatians 6:2 and 6:5 as using different Greek words for burden, so bearing others' burdens in sympathy differs from carrying one's own load of sin.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible lists Galatians 6:2's command to bear one another's burdens against 6:5's statement that each man bears his own as a flat contradiction.

sides.snippet: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
sides.verseText: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

sides.snippet: For each man will bear his own burden.
sides.verseText: For each man will bear his own burden.
